title: Chapter 96 Remote Places
content:
Chapter 96 Remote Places

Then Lu Xue looked up at An Xing in the distance, and laughed and said, "An Xing, I can't tell that you actually have this kind of hobby."

On the side, even Lu Daosheng covered his face and smiled.

What a good guy, it's just the contrast.

At this time, Awei had silently moved away from An Xing, and the expression on his face seemed to be saying.

I don't know him.

Listening to the wanton ridicule of everyone around him, An Xing's face turned red for a moment, and he returned to normal.

"Well, Miss, you misunderstood. In fact, this is a gift specially found for you by my subordinates."

An Xing said without blushing and his heart was beating.

How can you admit that you like pink unicorns? It's absolutely impossible.

He is a tough man, and he is also the darkest person in the deserted city. If he is known by outsiders or his own subordinates, will he still have prestige? Do you still have face?

Fortunately, everyone here is my own people.

Hearing An Xing's answer without any credibility, Lu Xue rolled her eyes, but then smiled and said, "Is that so? Then I'm not polite."

"Xiaoqing."

Suddenly, Ao Qing's little head faintly poked out from Lu Xue's sleeves. Judging from his expression, it seemed that he had not woken up.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue shook her head helplessly, and then handed the pink unicorn to Ao Qing's mouth.

"Come to Xiaoqing, have a meal."

"Oh, thank you little master."

Ao Qing said in a daze, not paying attention to what the pink thing was.

Lu Daosheng looked at Ao Qing on the side, but his expression slightly condensed.

When Ao Qing opened his bloody mouth and was about to end the pink unicorn in one bite, An Xing was anxious.

"Miss, stop!"

As the dark light flashed, An Xing instantly caught the pink unicorn and then hurriedly put it away.

This speed surprised everyone present.

"The realm of speed?"

Yu Qingfeng said in surprise.

On the side, Jiang Bei said in a deep voice: "There is another domain, the domain of nothingness. This is the first time I have seen this domain in reality."

"And both domains have reached the peak."

Hearing Jiang Bei's words, everyone's eyes at An Xing changed suddenly.

This kid hides deeply.

Aware of the strange gazes of everyone, An Xing smiled awkwardly, then looked at Lu Daosheng with his eyes asking for help.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng coughed lightly and said, "Okay, let's stop here."

As soon as these words came out, everyone immediately closed their mouths and looked at Lu Daosheng, waiting for the next words.

The next moment, as Lu Daosheng waved his hand.

Everyone disappeared in an instant.

In a hall full of sacred aura in the city lord's mansion.

Lu Daosheng sat on the only chair at the top, looking at the Huang Shuai below with a calm expression.

Lu Xue stood beside Lu Daosheng, looked left and right, then walked to Lu Daosheng in small steps, pinched his shoulders and back.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng immediately smiled with satisfaction.

Drink, grow up.

Next, Huang Shou and others reported for a long time.

He mainly talked about important matters in the recent deserted city.

"By the way, Lord of the City, the Immortal Imperial Clan has come to find subordinates not only once, but wants to lead the entire clan to join the wasteland city."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

Immortal Imperial Clan?

After a little recollection, Lu Daosheng began to remember.

In the world of all spirits, the existence as famous as the immortal immortal clan is, but now, whether it is the immortal immortal clan or the immortal imperial clan, in the eyes of his deserted city, they have become inequality.

It was also Li Changyue, the leader of the Changsheng Immortal Clan, who was foresighted and put down his face and led the entire clan to join the wasteland city in advance.

Nowadays, my life is still pretty good, but I just don’t have the power I used to do.

And now, the Immortal Imperial Clan also wants to join because of its jealousy.

Lu Daosheng smiled at this.

"Tell them that I have no shortage of people in the deserted city now, just let them find another high."

It was because of his whim when he agreed to the Changsheng Immortal Clan. However, the fact is that the Changsheng Immortal Clan has helped Huangcheng, but it is very little, and it is very small. The main reason why Huangcheng can develop to this point is because of the huge resources he has left behind.

Now, seeing that the Immortal Imperial Clan is developing so well, I want to share some benefits, so why?

I really think I am doing charity.

Lu Daosheng shook his head.

Seeing this, Gu Chen naturally would not say anything. In fact, he had already expected this.

What Emperor Ming thought was just a daydream.

Then Yun Qi sent troops to fight against some "unhonest" racial forces, which not only expanded the territory of the deserted city, but also greatly shocked countless forces with ill-hearted intentions.

Now the entire world of all spirits is their wasteland.

The other former top clans, dragon clans, phoenix clans, demon clans, etc., have led the entire clan to retreat to remote places in the world of all spirits.

As he said, avoid his sharpness for the time being.

The Dragon Clan and the Phoenix Clan both had a chance to soar to the sky back then, but unfortunately, they did not seize it.

On the side, Yu Qingfeng and Jiang Bei looked slightly surprised as they listened to the reports of An Xing and others.

Unexpectedly, the origin of this deserted city is actually that kind of small world.

only,,

The two of them looked at Lu Daosheng above.

Why did he spend huge amounts of money to create such a power in that place?

They can't figure it out.

But they believe that there must be an explanation.

I don’t know how long it took, but everything was finally reported.

Yun Qi cleared his throat and then retreated to the back.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng's expression above was slightly shocked. Was he finally finished speaking?

It's a hasty thing, it's been so long.

Looking down, Lu Xue had fallen asleep on her lap at some point.

I took pictures of Lu Xue.

"Xiaoxue, wake up."

"Hmm~ have you finished speaking?"

Lu Xue rubbed her eyes hazyly, but couldn't help but yawn.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng's eyes suddenly softened.

"Xiaoxue, you go down first. After your father has finished processing, he will go find you."

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded and said nothing. If she stayed here, she would be bored to death.

As if he had thought of something, Lu Xue looked at Luo Li and Ouyang Yanqing below.

This is one of the few women in the city.

Because Ouyang Yanqing had not come here with Lu Xue before, he then found a position in the deserted city of the Wanling Realm, Ouyang Yanqing could not leave now.

Lu Xue had no choice but to speak to Luo Li, "Luo Li, let's go first."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Luo Li was slightly stunned, looked at Lu Daosheng with a hesitation, and then looked at Yu Qingfeng beside him.

"Go."

Lu Daosheng Dao.

Anyway, it doesn't make any sense for Luo Li to stay here.

Yu Qingfeng nodded beside him.

Seeing this, Luo Li looked at Lu Xue gratefully, and then left with Lu Xue.

Here, she is still an ordinary person.

She was really uncomfortable after being here for so long.

After the two left, Lu Daosheng looked at the people below again.

“We are, to be honest, a bit remote.”

Lu Daosheng said lightly.

Upon hearing this, Huang Shou and others frowned slightly, not understanding why.

Yu Qingfeng and Jiangbei were silent.

Lu Daosheng has learned that powerful star domains will continue to conquer some weak star domains to expand their own fields and resources.

Whether it is the Xuanling Star Domain, the Wuling Star Domain or the Qingling Star Domain, the strength is not very strong.

At least before Lu Daosheng arrived, there was not even a powerful man in the Divine Emperor realm.
